preconditions: m0 and m1 are finite byte strings
m0 is not byte-for-byte equal to m1
relation.postcondition: SHA1(m0) equals SHA1(m1) using standard SHA-1 padding, IV, feed-forward, and 160-bit output

out_of_scope: compression-function collisions without a full hash collision
chosen-prefix claims not yielding an ordinary collision
